# RetroFoam of Michigan

> > Michigan's trusted spray foam insulation contractor serving homes, pole barns, and vans with energy-efficient retrofit and new construction solutions.

RetroFoam of Michigan specializes in closed-cell and open-cell spray foam insulation for residential and commercial applications across Michigan and surrounding regions. The company offers comprehensive services from consultation through installation, with transparent pricing, financing options, and utility rebate programs.

## Key Topics

- Spray Foam Insulation
- Injection Foam Insulation
- Energy Efficiency
- Home Insulation
- Attic Insulation
- Basement Insulation
- Crawl Space Insulation
- Pole Barn Insulation
- Air Sealing
- Retrofit Installation
- New Construction
- Michigan Contractor
- Home Comfort
- Financing & Rebates
- Cost Calculator

- [Spray Foam Insulation Contractors Michigan](https://www.retrofoamofmichigan.com/services): Main services page covering spray foam for homes and pole barns

- [Spray Foam Insulation for New Build Homes in Michigan](https://www.retrofoamofmichigan.com/new-home): Spray foam insulation for new construction homes in Michigan
- [Pole Barn Spray Foam Insulation](https://www.retrofoamofmichigan.com/pole-barn): Spray foam insulation for pole barns and metal buildings
- [Spray Foam Insulation for Cargo and Sprinter Vans](https://www.retrofoamofmichigan.com/van): Closed cell spray foam insulation for van conversions nationwide
- [Mobile Home Spray Foam Insulation](https://www.retrofoamofmichigan.com/mobile-home): Spray foam insulation for mobile and manufactured homes

## Application-Specific Solutions

- [Attic Spray Foam Insulation](https://www.retrofoamofmichigan.com/attic): Attic spray foam insulation to reduce energy bills
- [Injection Foam Insulation for Existing Walls in Michigan](https://www.retrofoamofmichigan.com/walls): Injection foam insulation for exterior walls in existing homes
- [Crawl Space Spray Foam Insulation](https://www.retrofoamofmichigan.com/crawl-space): Spray foam insulation for crawl spaces to prevent cold air leaks
- [Rim Joist Spray Foam Insulation](https://www.retrofoamofmichigan.com/rim-joist): Rim joist spray foam insulation to eliminate drafts and cold floors
- [Basement Spray Foam Insulation](https://www.retrofoamofmichigan.com/basement): Basement spray foam insulation for comfort and energy efficiency
- [Problems We Solve](https://www.retrofoamofmichigan.com/problems-we-solve): Solutions for high energy bills, drafts, and uncomfortable rooms
